contexts.name: Tiered Fetcher & Politeness
contexts.description: Fetches a URL on the cheapest engine that works and escalates (http -> browser -> claude) when content looks thin, fronted by a per-domain politeness governor and a content-addressed TTL cache.

contexts.name: App & Job Model
contexts.description: The contract a scraping app implements and the job lifecycle it runs in � job params, status, per-run context (engines, dataset store, artifacts dir), plus global config and error types.

contexts.name: Engine Capability Traits
contexts.description: Defines the capability interfaces every scraping app programs against � fetch, plugin execution, and search � so apps stay decoupled from concrete engine implementations.

contexts.name: Broad Crawler
contexts.description: Seed a set of URLs and crawl outward with a bounded, deduplicated frontier and thousands of concurrent fetch tasks, streaming page bodies to disk with robots.txt politeness and SimHash near-duplicate dropping.

contexts.name: Declarative Extraction Engine
contexts.description: Turn raw HTML/JSON documents into structured fields with a compiled rule set (CSS / regex / JSON pointer / constant) run in parallel across CPU cores, plus HTML-to-clean-Markdown preprocessing.

contexts.name: Dataset Store & Change Detection
contexts.description: Upsert typed records keyed by a stable id and learn whether each is new, changed, or unchanged since last run � the substrate for dedup and diff-based monitoring, with SimHash near-duplicate detection.

contexts.name: Full-Text Search Index
contexts.description: Embedded BM25 full-text search over scraped records using a memory-mapped Tantivy index � no external service; re-indexing an id replaces the prior document.

contexts.name: WASM Plugin Sandbox
contexts.description: Run untrusted, hot-swappable WebAssembly extraction/transform modules over documents with a CPU-fuel budget and hard memory cap (wasmtime), plus the bundled sample plugins.

contexts.name: Fetch Engines (HTTP / Browser / Claude)
contexts.description: The three fetch tiers: fast reqwest HTTP with cookie jar and backoff, a headless Chrome (chromiumoxide) engine with a persistent session for JS-heavy or gated pages, and the Claude Code CLI as an agentic research engine.

contexts.name: Configuration & Data Source Catalog
contexts.description: Service configuration and the curated catalog of data sources and connector API docs the apps and watchers operate against.

contexts.name: Live Events & Webhooks
contexts.description: Streams live job events to SSE subscribers and delivers finished job results to a caller-supplied callback URL with optional HMAC signing, so consumers never have to poll.

contexts.name: Job Worker & Cron Scheduler
contexts.description: Executes queued jobs against the right app and reconciles a DB-backed cron table each tick, enqueuing scheduled runs whose next firing is due.

contexts.name: DataHub Metadata Emitter
contexts.description: Pushes a metadata-only shadow of the dataset store (entities, inferred schema, run-derived lineage, freshness operations) to a DataHub GMS over its OpenAPI ingestion surface; fail-open on job success plus a one-shot backfill endpoint.

contexts.name: App Registry
contexts.description: The catalog of every scraping app the service can run, mapping app names to their implementations so new use cases become available by registering a crate.

contexts.name: HTTP API & Routes
contexts.description: The axum HTTP surface for the service � enqueue jobs, list apps/jobs/datasets, export records, search, and manage plugins � wired together with shared application state at startup.

contexts.name: EU & Regulatory Funding Watchers
contexts.description: Watches pan-EU open calls on the SEDIA Funding & Tenders Portal and CMS fee-schedule releases, capturing new/changed items over time for monitoring.

contexts.name: US Grant Opportunities
contexts.description: Pulls open grant opportunities from Grants.gov (federal Search2 API) and the California Grants Portal into queryable, deduplicated datasets.

contexts.name: US Trades Wages, Tax & Valuation
contexts.description: Claude-research-driven reference datasets for US home-services trades: wage bands, service pricing, state/federal income tax, and small-business valuation multiples.

contexts.name: Czech Labour Market (MPSV)
contexts.description: Builds Czech labour-market datasets: open vacancy aggregates from MPSV / �rad pr�ce CR and average-earnings benchmarks by CZ-ISCO from ISPV.

contexts.name: US Trades Business Density (Census)
contexts.description: Measures US trades-business density and self-employed receipts from the Census County Business Patterns and Nonemployer Statistics APIs.

contexts.name: Extraction, Crawl & API Watch
contexts.description: General-purpose tooling apps: declarative extraction over a URL list, broad outward crawling, running WASM plugins over pages, and monitoring connector API docs for changes.

contexts.name: Web Research & Readable Content
contexts.description: Example content apps: agentic web research via the Claude engine, fetching any URL as clean Markdown, and scraping the Hacker News front page.
